differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 45.6 fL) in a 57‑year‑old with obesity, low‑grade inflammation and risk factors for occult GI blood loss suggests iron deficiency.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic stress, viral sinusitis and possible low‑grade inflammation can cause a normocytic‑to‑microcytic anemia with low iron utilization.

differential.name: Colorectal carcinoma
differential.rationale: Age > 50, iron‑deficiency anemia and risk factors (obesity, dyslipidemia, smoking/drug misuse) raise concern for occult colon cancer as the bleeding source.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Mild microcytosis with relatively normal hemoglobin and RBC count can be seen in thalassemia minor, especially in a white adult.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with normal iron studies (not provided) and possible drug misuse (e.g., alcohol, isoniazid) could underlie a sideroblastic process.
